title: Seedance 2.5 Draft to 1080p
description: Draft completion endpoint for Seedance 2.5 - submit a draft id to regenerate the task at 1080p.

pricing.text: Your request will cost roughly $1.164 per second of generated video. Your request will cost roughly $0.0234 per 1000 tokens for 1080p video. The number of tokens is roughly given by (height of output video * width of output video * (input video duration + output video duration) * 24) / 1024. If video inputs are provided the price is multiplied by 0.6. With video references, you will be charged for both input and output videos.

inputs.name: draft_id
inputs.tooltip: The draft_id returned with draft enabled. Valid for seven days and only for the original caller.

inputs.name: codec
inputs.tooltip: 'auto' retains default video codec behaviour; 'H264' uses H.264; 'H265' uses H.265.
